vulnerability.name: Apache Tomcat Manager Default/Weak Credentials
vulnerability.author: Thomas Shaw
vulnerability.description:
The Apache Tomcat Manager application is left reachable over the network and protected only by a weak, well-known credential (tomcat:tomcat by default). An attacker who guesses the credential gains access to the Manager, which allows deploying an arbitrary WAR and so remote code execution as the Tomcat service account.
The misconfiguration is the combination of exposing the Manager app (the default install restricts it to localhost via a RemoteAddrValve) and granting a manager role to an account with a guessable password. Proven with the Metasploit auxiliary login scanner tomcat_mgr_login.

CyBOK.keyword: Cryptography and authentication (hashes and attacks against authentication schemes / passwords)
Vulnerabilities and attacks on access control misconfigurations
